text.arabic_uthmani: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ دَآئِبَيْنِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction that carries forward the prior enumeration
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as continuation, not as a detached start. The bound connector pulls the previous enumeration into this new clause, so the subjection of sun, moon, night, and day is heard as another item in the ongoing list of divine favors.

topics.headline: boundary continuation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah boundary falls inside a continuing enumeration rather than between unrelated statements.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as a coordinating conjunction, and the attachment evidence makes the first verbal clause coordinate with the prior act-chain.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect act of making serviceable, with explicit objects and a benefactive complement
words.root_gloss_range: subjection, service-compulsion, and status-reduction; the local Form II selects harnessing rather than mockery
words.prose: {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) is the first finite engine of the ayah: a completed Form II act that takes sun and moon as objects and routes the benefit through the following pronoun phrase. Its active surface keeps the prior divine subject recoverable, while accepted passive contrast only shows what would be lost if the agent were suppressed. The root family can include mockery and lowered status, but here that pressure is narrowed into service-compulsion: the bodies are not mocked, they are made functionally subject. This first occurrence also extends the adjacent subjection chain from 14:32 into a celestial pair.

topics.headline: active benefactive service frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb assigns sun and moon patienthood while keeping the benefited addressees and the prior divine agent grammatically active.
topics.reason: The local verb instance has explicit objects, a beneficiary preposition, perfect morphology, and a recoverable 3ms subject from the prior context.

topics.headline: passive variant agency contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the canonical active form foregrounds agency more directly than the passive variant would.
topics.reason: The variant is useful for contrast, but the local surface remains active and cannot be governed by the passive parse.

topics.headline: Form II status-reduction pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that harnessing is not mere availability; the Form II act makes powerful bodies function as assigned servants.
topics.reason: V4 supports subduing or making serviceable for the local root family, while local Form II and syntax prevent activating mockery as the selected sense.

topics.headline: celestial refrain escalation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this verb is both a local refrain-starter and a boundary handoff that lifts the subjection sequence from earthly provision into the sky.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence flags the provisioning refrain, and the critical rows link this occurrence to 14:32 and to the recurring sun-subjection association also visible in references such as (13:2), (16:12), (29:61), (31:29), (35:13), and (39:5).

words.gloss_range: benefactive and purposive prepositional phrase addressed to a second-person plural audience
words.prose: {{ar:لَكُمُ}} ({{tr:lakumu}}) places the addressed human collective immediately after the verb, before sun and moon are named. The phrase makes the cosmic act beneficiary-directed and purpose-shaped, but its possessive pressure must be narrowed: the luminaries are allocated for benefit, not transferred as owned property.

topics.headline: benefactive address vector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the clause tells for whom the cosmic subjection is directed before it names what is subjected.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the pronoun phrase the beneficiary complement of the first verb.

topics.headline: functional allocation not ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the addressees receive directed use and benefit, not cosmic ownership.
topics.reason: The preposition can carry purposive or possessive pressure, but the local objects are cosmic bodies governed by a subjection verb, so literal property transfer is too broad.

words.gloss_range: the known sun as a definite accusative object, paired with the moon and qualified by the later dual state
words.root_gloss_range: solar brightness and refractory-force associations; the local noun selects the unique luminary under harnessing
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) is the known singular sun, but grammar makes it an accusative patient of harnessing rather than an independent power. As the first named object, it opens the four-item sequence and leads the luminary pair before the ayah moves to temporal cycles. The later dual participle binds it with the moon as a shared ceaseless pair. Its brightness and refractory-force associations survive as pressure: the point is not a passive lamp, but a blazing force made serviceable.

topics.headline: known sun as harnessed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the reversal: the familiar source of light and heat is grammatically made an acted-upon object.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark a definite accusative noun functioning as the direct object of the first verb.

topics.headline: shared sun-moon state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sun is not interpreted alone; it is locked into the sun-moon doublet that the dual qualifier will describe.
topics.reason: The moon is coordinated with the sun, and the later dual state descriptor requires two referents.

topics.headline: radiant force made serviceable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sun's light and force sharpen the act of harnessing: what serves is powerful, not inert.
topics.reason: The local word is the concrete sun noun, so refractory imagery can color the harnessing but cannot replace the selected luminary sense.

topics.headline: ordered cosmic formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sun opens the ordered four-object sequence and leads the first pair before the ayah moves toward temporal cycles.
topics.reason: The word stands first in the sun-moon pair and participates in the recurring sun-subjection association attested in references such as (13:2), (16:12), (29:61), (31:29), (35:13), and (39:5).

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that joins the moon to the sun under the same verb
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) turns the moon into the sun's coordinated counterpart under the same act of harnessing. The connector builds the first two-item unit, so the later dual state can describe both objects together.

topics.headline: first-pair coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sun and moon form one governed pair, not two separate claims.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the following noun as coordinated with the sun and as an object of the same verb.

words.gloss_range: the known moon as the second definite accusative object, paired with the sun and sharing the later dual state
words.root_gloss_range: moon, moonlight, whiteness, phase-marking, and secondary-light associations; the local noun selects the celestial moon
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) completes the first object pair as a definite accusative noun under the same verb. Because the following participle is dual, the moon is not an add-on; it is required for the shared state of ceaseless operation. The ordering leaves the sun as source before the moon as reflected counterpart, so the first pair has internal direction before the ayah turns to night and day. Its root-family pressures of moonlight, whiteness, phases, and night guidance are narrowed into the local celestial noun, making the moon's service concrete as reflected light and time-marking without turning the word into a nonlocal action.

topics.headline: moon as second harnessed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon is independently subjected under the same verb, not merely appended to the sun.
topics.reason: The local noun is definite, accusative, coordinated with the sun, and an explicit object of the first verb.

topics.headline: dual-state completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon makes the later dual qualifier grammatically possible and shares the sun's ceaseless state.
topics.reason: The dual circumstantial descriptor attaches to the sun and moon together.

topics.headline: lunar light and phase pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon's service is materially intelligible through light, phases, and nighttime usability.
topics.reason: The concrete noun selects the moon itself; non-surface moonlight actions and dazzlement imagery can color the service but cannot govern the local parse.

topics.headline: cosmic counterpart order
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ordered source-then-counterpart movement before the ayah turns to night and day.
topics.reason: The moon is the second member of a strongly attested sun-moon dyad and closes the first pair before the participial state.

words.gloss_range: dual accusative active participle describing the sun and moon as ceaselessly engaged
words.root_gloss_range: toil, persistence, habit, and continuous operation; the local active participle makes routine cosmic service an ongoing state
words.prose: {{ar:دَآئِبَيْنِ}} ({{tr:dāʾibayni}}) is the ayah's explicit state descriptor. Its dual accusative form locks the description to sun and moon together, and its active participle makes them bear an ongoing role even while they are objects of harnessing. The root fuses labor with habit: their motion is not occasional effort but routine, ceaseless service. Its rare active-participle selection and hamza-heavy sound make that labor the marked close of the first beat before the ayah pivots to night and day.

topics.headline: dual circumstantial state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ceaseless state belongs exactly to the two luminaries and not to the later night-day pair.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a dual accusative circumstantial descriptor for the sun and moon.

topics.headline: active laboring routine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that subjected objects are pictured as workers whose service is both effort and habitual operation.
topics.reason: The active participle and low-occurrence contextual profile support an ongoing laboring state rather than a mere noun of custom.

topics.headline: rare sound-weighted hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first half lands on a rare, weighty form before the ayah resets into the night-day clause.
topics.reason: The local form is the only active-participle occurrence in the supplied profile, closes the first clause, and has a sound shape that reinforces the semantic weight.

words.gloss_range: clause-level conjunction that links the second subjection beat to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the internal hinge. It does not simply add another noun; it restarts the same verb pattern and shifts the ayah from the qualified sun-moon pair into the bare night-day pair.

topics.headline: second-beat hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pivot from one complete subjection beat to a parallel second beat with a new domain.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the second verb as coordinated with the first and the second clause as parallel to the first.

words.gloss_range: second Form II perfect act of harnessing, repeating the verb-beneficiary-object frame for night and day
words.root_gloss_range: subjection and service-compulsion; locally repeated to extend harnessing from celestial bodies to temporal cycles
words.prose: The second {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) repeats the exact active Form II frame, but now its objects are night and day. That repetition makes temporal cycles acted-upon service objects just as sun and moon were, while the lack of a matching state descriptor leaves this second pair bare. The passive variant again works only as contrast: the local active form keeps the prior divine agency direct. Structurally, the verb completes the ayah's anaphora and, as the final verb in the adjacent 14:32-33 subjection run, gives the sequence a fourfold cadence into time itself.

topics.headline: repeated active service frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second half is not a new construction; it repeats the same verb-beneficiary-object architecture for a new object domain.
topics.reason: The second verb instance repeats the first frame with an explicit beneficiary phrase and two explicit coordinated objects.

topics.headline: passive variant agency contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the active surface keeps the act of subjection direct, while the passive variant would foreground the objects differently.
topics.reason: The variant is a valid contrast, but the canonical local morphology is active and retains the same omitted subject pattern as word 2.

topics.headline: bodies-to-cycles domain shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scope expansion: what was applied to physical luminaries is now applied to time cycles.
topics.reason: The same local verb sense governs different object classes, moving from concrete celestial bodies to abstract temporal nouns.

topics.headline: bare second-pair asymmetry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night and day are subjected without the explicit ceaseless-labor qualifier given to sun and moon.
topics.reason: The second clause has no circumstantial state parallel to the first clause's dual participle.

topics.headline: anaphora boundary completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final repeated verb completes a fourfold adjacent-ayah subjection cadence and binds the two halves of this ayah.
topics.reason: The row set links this final local verb to the exact word-2 reprise and to the repeated root sequence across 14:32-33.

words.gloss_range: repeated benefactive prepositional phrase, renewing the same addressee for night and day
words.prose: The second {{ar:لَكُمُ}} ({{tr:lakumu}}) repeats the beneficiary phrase after the repeated verb, so the human-directed service is not exhausted by the sun-moon clause. The same addressees are held constant while the objects change to night and day, making benefit itself a refrain across both halves.

topics.headline: beneficiary refrain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same audience is deliberately renewed when the ayah shifts from luminaries to temporal cycles.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the second phrase the beneficiary complement of the second verb, parallel to word 3.

topics.headline: mislocalized root note
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The row discusses the root of the final day word and the prior ayah, not the local beneficiary phrase.
topics.reason: The local word is a rootless prepositional phrase, so this root note has no word-10 payoff and is retained only in coverage.

words.gloss_range: the known night cycle as a definite accusative object under the second harnessing verb
words.root_gloss_range: night, darkness, covering, and recurring nighttime phenomenon; the local noun selects the cycle rather than an adverbial time
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّيْلَ}} ({{tr:al-layla}}) is not merely when something happens; in this clause night is what is harnessed. Its definite abstract form presents the known recurring nighttime phenomenon, and its nominal profile keeps it as an entity in the inventory rather than an action. A recorded derivational dispute remains live as morphology, but it does not change the local night-cycle sense. The covering and rest-phase pressures make the benefit concrete: darkness and dormancy themselves become ordered service. The word also opens a pending night-day pair, completed only by the final coordinated noun.

topics.headline: night as harnessed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night is acted upon as a subjected phenomenon, not used adverbially as background time.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the word as a definite accusative direct object of the second verb.

topics.headline: whole-cycle nominal phenomenon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word selects night as the recurring phenomenon as a whole, not a single night or verbal process.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite abstract noun, and the contextual profile is overwhelmingly nominal.

topics.headline: covering rest benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how the benefit of night can be understood through concealment, rest, and low-activity rhythm.
topics.reason: The semantic evidence coheres with the local noun without displacing the selected night-cycle sense.

topics.headline: root dispute without sense change
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a live morphological dispute while keeping the local meaning stable as night.
topics.reason: The dispute does not alter the local night meaning or the object's grammar, so it remains a narrowed apparatus note.

topics.headline: pending night-day pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night begins the second pair and waits syntactically for day to complete the cycle.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates day with night, and the collocation profile shows a strong night-day pairing.

words.gloss_range: final coordinating conjunction that joins day to night and completes the second object pair
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) closes the pending temporal dyad by binding day to night under the same verb. Its fused movement into the final noun delays closure until daylight is named, mirroring the earlier connector that bound moon to sun.

topics.headline: final-pair closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the last connector does not start a new claim; it completes the night-day object pair and the ayah's parallel design.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the final noun as coordinated with night and as an object of the second verb.

words.gloss_range: the known daylight cycle as the final definite accusative object, coordinated with night
words.root_gloss_range: daylight, river/flow, and rebuke branches; the local noun selects daylight while the adjacent river echo keeps flow imagery available
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارَ}} ({{tr:al-nahāra}}) closes the ayah as the final acted-upon object: daylight is harnessed, not merely used as an adverbial time. The form selects the known daylight cycle and blocks the rebuke branch as a local sense, while its active visible interval makes the benefit concrete. Because 14:32 ended with rivers from the same root family, this final word also narrows a water-flow echo into daylight: the sense is day, but the boundary lets flowing water and flowing light answer each other. Structurally, it completes the night-day pair and the four-item field of sun, moon, night, and day.

topics.headline: daylight as final object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that daylight itself is made a subjected object at the ayah's close.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence mark the final word as a definite accusative noun coordinated with night under the second verb.

topics.headline: daylight sense narrowed from root branches
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the selected sense is the daylight period, not a rebuke action, causative flow, or adverbial daytime span.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite abstract noun in object position within the night-day pair, so other root branches and adverbial forms are contrastive rather than selected.

topics.headline: visible active benefit
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices how daylight's service becomes concrete through visibility and active usable time.
topics.reason: The definite daylight-cycle noun coheres with a usable visible interval under the benefactive harnessing frame.

topics.headline: river-daylight boundary echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a boundary handoff from flowing water in 14:32 to flowing daylight at the end of 14:33.
topics.reason: The local word still means daylight, but the previous ayah's closing river word in 14:32 makes the shared-root water/day contrast locally visible.

topics.headline: four-item closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that daylight is the landing point that completes the two-pair structure of celestial bodies and temporal cycles.
topics.reason: The final noun completes the coordinated night-day pair and the ordered sun-moon then night-day distribution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of سَخَّرَ لَكُم frame sun/moon and night/day, while دَائِبَيْنِ grammatically binds the two luminaries as continuously active.
baseline_models.mechanism: One agent renders two celestial bodies and two temporal conditions tractable toward the addressees' benefit. The repeated construction coordinates luminous motion with temporal alternation, and دَائِبَيْنِ makes the service ongoing rather than a one-time gift.

activation_trace.role: Making a thing tractable and driving it toward a purpose supplies the governing relation for both coordinated pairs.
Uninterrupted application in movement or work turns the sun and moon into continuously operating servants.
The sun, its disk, and its illumination provide the bright member of the celestial pair.
The heavenly moon and its light provide the nocturnal luminary paired with the sun.
Night as darkness and the contrary of day supplies one temporal operating condition.
Day's opening in light supplies the complementary temporal operating condition.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a list of four useful natural phenomena.
changed_reading.after: The ayah depicts a coordinated service regime: luminous bodies keep working while night and day furnish alternating conditions, all purposefully made available to the addressees.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated causative سَخَّرَ, the beneficiary phrase لَكُم, and the labor-like dual دَائِبَيْنِ permit a work relation to be heard inside the cosmic description.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant labor branch of سخر casts the subjected bodies as workers whose output accrues to others, while a branch of دأب intensifies the image into work kept up to the point of weariness. The result is an ethically charged image of ceaseless cosmic labor for human beneficiaries.

activation_trace.role: Compelled work without wages contributes the labor relation carried by the repeated causative and assigns its output to لَكُم.
Keeping another at work until tired supplies the extractive edge of the ceaseless dual activity.
Continuous exertion keeps the labor image anchored in the surface force of دَائِبَيْنِ.

changed_reading.after: The wording can also stage the cosmos as a workforce kept continuously at its task for the addressees, an exploratory pressure that asks how beneficiary-directed power differs from exploitation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَخَّرَ directly governs ٱلشَّمْسَ, whose root inventory includes the image of a restive animal that refuses settled use.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tractability branch of سخر crosses with the restiveness branch of شمس: predictable solar service is read not as inert mechanism but as recalcitrant force held to a continuous course. دَائِبَيْنِ makes successful governance visible as regularity.

activation_trace.role: Taming and driving toward a purpose supplies the control exerted over potentially unruly force.
A restive mount that will not settle supplies the counterimage whose resistance is overcome in solar regularity.
Unbroken movement is the observable result of that governance.

changed_reading.before: The sun's regularity is merely automatic.
changed_reading.after: The sun's regularity can be heard as governed restiveness: a formidable, potentially untractable power is kept continuously on a beneficial course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first gives a directed passage from darkness into illumination. When that construction meets the focus ayah's subjected night and day, their alternation becomes a recurring sensible enactment of directed emergence, not merely a morally symmetrical clock.

activation_trace.role: Night's darkness supplies the recurring departure condition of the contextual passage.
Day opening in light supplies the recurring arrival condition.
Illumination is the explicit goal of the surah's opening movement and gives the physical alternation a directional analogue.

structural_cues: 14:1 uses مِنَ ٱلظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ, a from-to construction rather than a static juxtaposition.
14:33 places night before day inside a repeated subjection construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a directed darkness-to-light passage and a literal night/day alternation; I infer that the latter can repeatedly stage the former. A live alternative is that the two remain separate, one ethical-cognitive and one purely material.

changed_reading.before: Night and day are equally useful alternating periods.
changed_reading.after: Without losing literal alternation, night-to-day can also function as a continually renewed image of being brought from obscurity into illumination.

context_deltas.mechanism: The early rescue scene distinguishes oppressive imposition on people from the focus ayah's beneficiary-directed subjection of cosmic powers. The labor branches of سخر and دأب remain live, but لَكُم now reverses their ethical direction: burdens are borne by the cosmic order for the rescued community rather than imposed by rulers upon it.

activation_trace.role: Compelled unpaid labor supplies the potentially troubling work relation that context ethically reorients.
Sustained work that tires another sharpens the contrast with abusive human power.
Deliverance by separation supplies the release side of the social reversal.
Imposing and binding someone to evil supplies the oppressive countermodel of subjection.

structural_cues: 14:6 places rescue from Pharaoh's house directly against what they repeatedly imposed on the addressees.
14:33 repeats لَكُم after each سَخَّرَ, marking beneficiaries rather than victims.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rescue from imposed harm, labor-like branches, and repeated beneficiary marking; I infer an ethical reversal between human enslavement and cosmic service. The alternative is that the labor branches are merely lexical counterimages with no social critique.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic labor is an extractive image in which humans simply receive others' work.
changed_reading.after: In the surah's liberation frame, the image can reverse tyranny: people delivered from imposed service inhabit an order where nonhuman powers are commissioned for their benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adversary later denies having coercive power and reduces his action to a call that humans answered. That sequence draws a categorical boundary around the focus ayah: sun, moon, night, and day are actually subjected, whereas morally answerable humans are addressed and respond.

activation_trace.role: Actual tractability and directed service establish the nonhuman side of the contrast.
Coercive overpowering force is explicitly denied to the caller over human hearers.
Verbal calling and inclination replace coercion as the mechanism acting on humans.
Answering speech supplies the human act that completes the noncoercive relation.

structural_cues: 14:22 states مَا كَانَ لِىَ عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَانٍ إِلَّا أَن دَعَوْتُكُمْ فَٱسْتَجَبْتُمْ لِى.
14:33 makes the celestial and temporal terms direct objects of سَخَّرَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies real cosmic subjection and a human call-response sequence from which coercive power is excluded; I infer a contrast in modes of governance. A live alternative is that 14:22 limits only one speaker's power without making a general anthropology.

changed_reading.before: Subjection is a general template for every creature's relation to power.
changed_reading.after: The ayah helps mark a boundary: cosmic systems are compelled into regular service, but humans in the surah remain responders whose choices cannot be excused as cosmic-style compulsion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The stable tree does not merely remain in place; it repeatedly yields nourishment at its proper times. That sequence sharpens دَائِبَيْنِ into productive constancy: the sun/moon cycle and night/day alternation are reliable precisely because their recurrence enables timed yield.

activation_trace.role: A continuing habit or condition supplies regular recurrence rather than static persistence.
Durability and fixedness supply the stable basis from which recurrent production can occur.
The yield of tree and crop supplies the material output of constancy.
The proper time of a thing links yield to recurring temporal opportunity.

structural_cues: 14:24-25 joins a fixed root to giving its yield كُلَّ حِينٍ.
14:33 joins continuous celestial activity to the night/day pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stable rootedness, recurrent timed yield, and unbroken celestial work; I infer that the cycles are enabling conditions for productivity. The alternative is a looser analogy between two independent forms of constancy.

changed_reading.before: Ceaseless motion is valuable because it never stops.
changed_reading.after: Ceaseless motion is fruitful constancy: dependable cycles repeatedly open the right time for nourishment and growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah forms a chain from descending water to edible provision, then to a subjected vessel running through the sea by divine command, then to subjected rivers. The focus ayah extends the same syntax into light and time. Together they form one provision, transport, water, energy, and temporal infrastructure whose benefits are delegated to humans while command remains with God.

activation_trace.role: Nourishing provision identifies the output toward which the material chain is organized.
Repeated tractability for a purpose establishes the same governing relation on both sides of the ayah boundary.
The vessel moving in water supplies the transport component of the infrastructure.
Flowing and free movement provide the operative motion enabled by subjection.
The broad mass of water supplies the field through which transport is made possible.
Binding command locates effective authority with God rather than with the human beneficiary.
Rivers as channels cut by abundant flowing water supply distributed material circulation.
The focus repeats the same subjection relation and extends the network into celestial and temporal domains.
Continuous operation makes the extended infrastructure dependable.

structural_cues: 14:32 and 14:33 repeat وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم across the ayah boundary.
The ship runs بِأَمْرِهِ even though it is subjected لَكُم.
The sequence moves from rain and fruit to ship, sea, rivers, sun, moon, night, and day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a contiguous causal-material sequence, repeated syntax, and explicit divine command; I infer a single integrated infrastructure and the distinction between usufruct and ownership. The alternative is a rhetorical catalogue whose items need not form one system.

changed_reading.before: The focus adds cosmic examples to a general list of favors.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes an integrated infrastructure: water and transport circulate goods, while sun, moon, night, and day continuously supply the energetic and temporal conditions of that circulation, for human use but under divine command.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, humans cannot enumerate or exhaustively count divine benefits; later a Day of account arrives and every self's earning is swiftly reckoned. The tireless luminaries and repeating night/day pair become an asymmetric ledger: each cycle posts benefits humans cannot total while also advancing the time in which human acts accrue toward exact account.

activation_trace.role: Continuing habitual recurrence supplies the repeated posting rhythm of the proposed ledger.
The heavenly moon and its changing nocturnal presence supply one visible recurrent marker.
The bounded daylight interval supplies a repeated unit of lived time.
Enumerating what is counted supplies the human attempt that fails before the abundance of benefits.
Beneficent good condition identifies the repeated cosmic services as entries in a gift inventory.
Exhaustive numerical reckoning supplies the stronger totalization humans cannot perform.
The consequential event called a day supplies the terminal accounting horizon.
Counting and account identify what stands at that horizon.
Acquiring gain supplies the act-side entries attributed to each self.
The contrary of slowness characterizes the final reckoning despite the long recurrent process.
Exact account closes the asymmetry between uncounted gifts and counted human acquisition.

structural_cues: 14:34 immediately follows the fourfold cosmic service with وَإِن تَعُدُّوا نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَا.
14:41 names the day on which account stands, and 14:51 assigns recompense to each self for what it earned.
14:33 combines recurring luminaries with the night/day pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent temporal phenomena, failed human enumeration of benefits, and successful divine accounting of earnings; I supply the ledger metaphor and the arrow from each cycle to temporal accrual. The alternative is that blessing-count and judgment-account are parallel contrasts without the focus acting as their register.

changed_reading.before: Each day-night cycle simply renews utility.
changed_reading.after: Each cycle can be read as both a fresh, uncountable credit of provision and another interval in which human earnings accumulate toward a swiftly exact account.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning not to suppose God inattentive is followed by purposeful delay to a charged Day, then by a warning not to suppose the promise broken. Against that sequence, the continuously working sun and moon and unfailing night/day alternation become a material counterimage to neglect: postponement is scheduled governance, not lapse.

activation_trace.role: Uninterrupted application and movement supply the visible counterimage to inattention.
A continuing established course supplies dependable temporal governance.
Supposition identifies the mistaken interpretation of apparent delay.
Inattention that leaves something outside vigilance supplies the explicitly rejected model.
Deferral to a later time supplies purposeful postponement rather than omission.
A charged day-event supplies the destination toward which delay runs.
A promise failing at its due time supplies the second explicitly rejected model.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the commitment whose fulfillment remains active.

structural_cues: 14:42 says إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ immediately after denying غفلة.
14:47 repeats فَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ and denies that God breaks His promise.
14:33 places دَائِبَيْنِ inside an ordered alternation visible every day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies uninterrupted cosmic operation, explicit denial of inattention, purposeful deferral, and promise fidelity; I infer that the cycles function as an enacted analogy of active scheduling. The alternative is that cosmic regularity demonstrates power generally without commenting on delayed judgment.

changed_reading.before: The cycles show dependable natural regularity.
changed_reading.after: Their tireless regularity can also answer the anxiety of delay: governance continues without lapse, and recurring time is carrying events toward a promised day rather than concealing neglect.

context_deltas.mechanism: Claims of no removal, plots imagined to move mountains, and the eventual replacement of earth and heavens bound the scope of دَائِبَيْنِ. Its continuity is the perfect execution of a present commission, not self-grounded permanence or endlessness.

activation_trace.role: Continuous movement supplies the apparent permanence that context qualifies.
An established ongoing condition supplies continuity within the current order, not proof of eternity.
Removal from a place or state names the permanence that the speakers wrongly deny.
Displacement supplies the imagined destabilization of even mountains.
The consequential Day supplies the boundary event for the present cosmic arrangement.
Changing a thing's form supplies the explicit transformation of earth and heavens.

structural_cues: 14:44 reports the prior oath that there would be no زوال.
14:46 places زوال against mountains, while 14:48 explicitly changes earth and heavens.
14:33 describes continuous operation but contains no term for eternity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present continuity and later cosmic transformation; I infer that the former is commissioned tenure. A live alternative is that دَائِبَيْنِ concerns only intensity of work and never invited an eternity claim to begin with.

changed_reading.before: Tireless sun and moon imply an indefinitely self-maintaining cosmic order.
changed_reading.after: They operate without interruption for their assigned tenure; the same sovereign who maintains the cycle can terminate and transform its entire field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah condemns rival counterparts and closes by asserting one deity, while the transformed cosmos is exposed before the One who overpowers from above. In that frame, the focus grammar de-sovereignizes sun and moon: however great their effects, they are coordinated objects under one repeated subject, not peer powers.

activation_trace.role: Being made tractable and driven toward another's purpose places the cosmic bodies below the governing agent.
The visibly powerful sun is retained as a real luminary but grammatically denied independent sovereignty.
The moon and its light form the second prominent body subordinated within one order.
A rival counterpart supplies the rejected model of multiple peer powers.
Divine oneness without partner identifies the single sovereign before whom the cosmos appears.
Overpowering from above and rendering the overcome low supplies the ultimate sovereignty behind cosmic subjection.
The closing declaration of one deity confirms the surah-wide anti-rival frame.

structural_cues: 14:30 makes rivals a cause of deviation from the path.
14:33 gives one repeated verbal subject control over four cosmic objects.
14:48 and 14:52 repeat divine oneness near the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies condemned rivals, one overpowering deity, and cosmic bodies as objects of subjection; I infer that the focus is polemical as well as beneficent. The alternative is a nonpolemical gift catalogue whose grammar only incidentally supports the unity theme.

changed_reading.before: Sun and moon are impressive gifts administered by God.
changed_reading.after: Their very subjection argues against treating impressive cosmic powers as rivals: many great operations disclose one governing sovereignty.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the 14:32 occurrence of فلك is the vessel, while the cited branch reaches the celestial course; it remains valid as a packet-supplied branch activation reinforced by repeated سخر and by جري beside the focus's moving luminaries. Downstream prose should call it a navigation analogy, not claim that the surface word in 14:32 literally denotes an orbit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's sun and moon are dual continuous movers under the same وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم construction that governs the immediately preceding vessel.

activation_trace.role: The waterborne vessel supplies the literal navigation image in the preceding ayah.
The celestial sphere and course of heavenly bodies bridge the vessel image into the focus's sun and moon.
Flowing movement supplies the shared kinematics of the ship and the proposed celestial fleet.
The sun supplies one actual celestial body carried into the navigation analogy.
The moon supplies the second actual celestial body in the paired course.
Continuous movement gives the imagined celestial vessels their unwavering voyage.

changed_reading.before: The ship and the luminaries are separate examples of useful things.
changed_reading.after: The repeated syntax can momentarily render sun and moon as a celestial fleet: continuously coursing above as the commanded vessel runs through the sea below.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it moves from the river branch of نهر in 14:32 to the day branch of the same root in 14:33; it remains tightly anchored by adjacent occurrences, identical subjection syntax, and دَائِبَيْنِ. Downstream prose should present a root-branch resonance in which day is river-like, not replace the ordinary meaning of ٱلنَّهَار.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلنَّهَارَ in the focus follows subjected ٱلْأَنْهَارَ in the adjacent ayah, and both stand after وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم.

activation_trace.role: A channel cut through earth by abundant flowing water supplies the material river image.
Day opening in illumination supplies the surface temporal sense connected to that river image.
Opening and widening until something flows supplies the mechanism for construing daylight as an opened temporal channel.
Uninterrupted movement makes the temporal channel continually renew.

changed_reading.before: Rivers provide flowing water, while day provides a bright interval.
changed_reading.after: Across the ayah boundary, day can resonate as a temporal river: an opened channel through which light, work, provision, and accountable time keep flowing.

strongest_changes: The immediate 14:32-33 sequence turns the focus from an isolated cosmic list into delegated infrastructure spanning provision, transport, water, light, and time.
The surah's denial of coercive authority over humans sharply distinguishes moral call-and-response from the actual subjection of celestial systems.
Uncountable benefits and exact final account make the recurring cycles an asymmetric ledger of provision received and action accrued.
The denial of divine inattention makes tireless cosmic regularity a counterimage to apparent delay, while later cosmic transformation limits that regularity to an assigned tenure.
summary.what_was_special: The most distinctive activation came from the adjacent repetition of وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم and the packet's فلك and نهر branch crossings: ship can evoke celestial course, and subjected rivers can make subjected day resonate as flowing time. The labor branches of سخر and دأب also changed substantially when read through rescue from imposed oppression and the later call-response account of human agency.
remaining_uncertainties: The labor and restiveness readings are visibly anchored but depend on form-distant branch images rather than the dominant surface senses.
The celestial-fleet and temporal-river readings may be deliberate adjacency effects or reader-generated analogies; they should not be promoted to lexical glosses.
The ledger model depends on treating recurrent luminaries and day/night as temporal markers linking nearby gift-counting to later judgment-accounting.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Cosmic service is continuous labor that makes time usable.** `س خ ر` `B001` (purpose-bound command), `ش م س` `B001` (sun/daylight), `ق م ر` `B001` (moon/light), `د ء ب` `B001` (continuous striving), `ل ي ل` `B001` (night), and `ن ه ر` `B002` (day opening with light) form a temporal engine. The repeated “for you” and later appointed day supply the human horizon. I infer persistent alternation converts celestial motion into measure, labor, and occasion. The ayah reads as time itself rendered serviceable.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The appointed day in 14:42–44 activated a judicial edge in the cosmic time-engine: the same ordered sequence that supports life also carries deferred acts to their limit.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Cosmic service is persistent labor, not inert availability.** `س خ ر B001` supplies being brought under command for a purpose, and `د ء ب B001` steady persistence in continuous striving. The doubled `سَخَّرَ` extends 14:32's water and transport system into recurring celestial and temporal motion; 14:34 names the resulting favors beyond enumeration. The packet supplies command, persistence, and benefit; I infer an ongoing service relation. `دَائِبَيْن` makes provision dynamically maintained.
2. **Day is a temporal flow parallel to the river.** `ن ه ر B002` supplies day opening with light and `ن ه ر B003` opening or widening until something flows. Its immediate predecessor in 14:32 is `ٱلْأَنْهَار` under the same repeated subjection formula. I infer that the shared root lets temporal opening perform a river-like role: activity flows through the opened day. This does not merge river and day, but it makes their coordinated service newly visible.
3. **Night/day govern hidden/manifest modes.** `ل ي ل B001` supplies night and darkness, while `ن ه ر B002` supplies daylight opening. 14:31 pairs secret and public expenditure, and 14:38 pairs what people hide and declare. The packet supplies the repeated binary; I infer that cosmic alternation models the legitimacy and governability of both visibility modes. `ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَار` reads as a temporal framework that contains inward and outward action alike.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 14:38 repeated the hidden/manifest binary at the far edge of the window. That later epistemic pair confirmed that night/day are not only time units but a governed framework for inward and outward action.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gökteki güneşi, onun görünen yuvarlak yüzünü ve yayılan ışığını aynı çekirdekte toplar; ayrıca günün güneşli oluşunu, bir şeyin güneşte yapılmasını ve kişinin güneşe çıkmasını belirli biçim ve kuruluşlarla bildirir. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu ayrımları doğru biçimde kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın güneş anlamını merkezde tutar; günün güneşli olması, güneşte yapılma ve güneşe yönelme anlamlarını ise tanıklanan biçim ve söz öbekleriyle sınırlar.

concept_map.definition: Gökte görülen güneş, onun yuvarlak yüzü ve ondan yayılan ışık bu dalın çekirdeğidir. Belirli kuruluşlarda bir günün bütünüyle güneşli olması, bir şeyin güneşte yapılması ve kişinin güneşe çıkıp ona yönelmesi de anlatılır.

facets.statement: Güneş, gökteki bilinen cisim, onun görünen yuvarlak yüzü ve çevreye yayılan ışığıdır.
Güneşli gün kuruluşu, gündüzünün bütünü güneşli olan günü ve günün güneşinin güçlenmesini bildirir.
Türetilmiş biçimler, bir şeyin güneşte yapılmasını ya da kişinin güneşe çıkıp ona yönelmesini bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar güneşi hem gökteki cisim ve görünen yuvarlak yüz hem de ondan yayılan ışık olarak verir. Aynı kanıt kümesi, güneşli günü ve güneşte yapılma ya da güneşe çıkma bildiren bağlı kullanımları da içerir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi hayvanda yerinde durmama ve sırtını kullandırmama, insanda kaçıp durulmama ve zor mizaç, kadında ise kuşkulu durumdan ürküp uzaklaşma özelliklerini aynı kaçınma ve kararsızlık alanında verir. Sunulan dal çerçevesi bu katmanları korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği ürküp kaçınma ve durulmama halidir; atın sırtını kullandırmaması ile insanın huysuzluğu bunun katılımcıya göre özelleşmeleridir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dal, hayvan ve insan için kaçınma, yerinde ya da tutumunda durmama ve güçlük çıkarma çekirdeğiyle tanımlanır; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Hayvanın ya da insanın ürküp kaçınması ve bir yerde veya tutumda durulmaması bu dalın çekirdeğidir. Hayvanda dürtülünce sırtını kullandırmama, insanda zor ve değişken mizaç, kadında ise kuşkulu durumdan uzak durma biçimlerinde gerçekleşir.

facets.statement: Canlı, ürküp kaçar, bir yerde ya da tutumda durulmaz ve kolayca denetim altına girmez.
At ya da başka bir binek hayvanı dürtülünce yerinde durmaz ve sırtını biniciye kullandırmaz.
İnsan için zor, huysuz ve bir tutumda kalmayan mizaç; kadın için kuşkulu durumdan ürküp uzak durma anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar hayvanın yerinde durmamasını ve özellikle atın sırtını kullandırmamasını, insandaki zor ve değişken mizacı ve kuşkulu durumdan kaçınmayı aynı anlam alanında birleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı türemiş biçim çevresinde arkasındakini engelleyip koruyan adamı, topluluğunu güçlü biçimde savunan kişiyi ve iyiliğini vermeyen cimriyi; ayrıca yalnız belirli bir kuruluşta birilerine cimrilik etmeyi birlikte verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak savunma ve topluluk bağlılığı genel cimriliğe indirgenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Koruma ve güçlü topluluk dayanışması bir insan niteliğidir; iyiliği esirgeme ve birilerine cimrilik etme ise ayrı fakat ilişkili kişi ve kuruluş kullanımlarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım türemiş kişi niteliğini, cimri kişi kullanımını ve birilerine cimrilik etme kuruluşunu ayrı tutar; bunlardan yalın köke genel bir koruma ya da cimrilik anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Türemiş kişi biçimi, arkasında bulunanı başkasından koruyup engelleyen veya topluluğunu güçlü biçimde savunan adamı; ayrıca iyiliğine erişilemeyen cimriyi bildirir. Belirli bir kişiye yönelen kuruluşta ise iyiliğini esirgeyip ona cimrilik etmek anlatılır.

facets.statement: Türemiş kişi biçimi, arkasında bulunanı başkasının erişiminden koruyan ve engelleyen adamı bildirir.
Aynı kişi niteliği, kendi topluluğunu güçlü biçimde savunma ve ona sıkı bağlılık gösterme olarak açıklanır.
Kişi, kendisinden hiçbir iyiliğe erişilemeyen cimri olarak da nitelenir.
Kişiye yönelen belirli kuruluş, birilerine karşı cimrilik edip iyiliği esirgemeyi bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, koruyup engelleme ile güçlü topluluk bağlılığını bir kişi niteliğinde; iyiliğine erişilemeyen cimriyi ve birilerine cimrilik etmeyi ise ilişkili fakat ayrı kullanımlarda toplar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gökteki Ay'ı, onun ışığını ve bu ışıkla aydınlanan geceyi aynı anlam alanında açıkça birleştirir. Ay adının hilalden sonraki günlerde ya da dolunay evresinde kullanılması kaynaklar arasındaki kapsam farkıdır; gök cismi ile ışık çekirdeğini değiştirmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gök cismini ve onun ışığını kapsar; Ay'a benzeyen renkleri ya da yalnızca dolunaydaki tamamlanmayı kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, Ay'ın yalın adını ışık, aydınlık gece ve doğma bildiren yapıya bağlı kullanımlardan ayırarak birlikte gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Gökteki Ay ile ondan yayılan ışığı ve bu ışığın geceyi aydınlatmasını anlatır. Bazı kaynaklar Ay adının hilalden sonraki günlerde, bazıları ise özellikle dolunayda kullanıldığını belirtir.

facets.statement: Temel gönderim, gökte görülen Ay adlı gök cismidir.
Ay'ın ışığı, bu ışıkla aydınlanan gece ve Ay'ın bir topluluk üzerine doğması aynı dala bağlı kullanımlardır.
Ay adının başlangıç sınırı hilalden sonraki birkaç geceyle, belirgin evresi ise dolunayla ilişkilendirilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gökteki Ay, ay ışığı ve ayla aydınlanan gece üzerinde birleşir; adın ayın hangi evresinden itibaren öne çıktığı konusunda hilal sonrası ile dolunay arasında farklı sınırlar verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ay ışığında birine gitmeyi, avcının veya aslanın gece ava çıkmasını, kuş ya da ceylanların görüşünü şaşırtarak onları yakalamayı ve birinin gafletinden yararlanmayı aynı dalda toplar. Verilen çerçeve kullanılabilir, ancak anlam genel olarak yönelmek veya avlanmak değildir; ay aydınlığı, gece görüşü ya da hazırlıksız yakalama koşulu korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca ay ışığında yaklaşma ve gece avında görüşü şaşırtıp gafil yakalama kullanımlarını kapsar; genel avlanma veya genel aldatma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, birbirine bağlı fakat ayrı yapılardaki ay ışığında yaklaşma, gece ava çıkma ve avın görüşünü şaşırtma kullanımlarını karıştırmadan gösterir.

concept_map.definition: Birine ay ışığında yaklaşmayı veya gece ava çıkmayı anlatır; av bağlamında ışık ya da karanlık yüzünden görüşü şaşan hayvanı hazırlıksız yakalayıp avlama sonucuna uzanır. Bir kişinin gafletinden yararlanıp onu aldatma kullanımı da bu hazırlıksız yakalama çizgisine bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişiye ay ışığında gitmek veya yaklaşmak dalın temel gece koşullu kullanımıdır.

facets.statement: Taşkın ya da bol suyu taşıyan ve toprağı yararak belirginleşen doğal bir su yatağıdır.

Su yatağının kendine sağlam ve yerleşik bir güzergah edinmesi yapı bağlı bir kullanımdır.
Suyun kazıp oluşturduğu belirli yatak yeri de bu dal içinde adlandırılır.
Kuyu kazısının yer altındaki su düzeyine ulaşması, suya varma sonucunu bildiren bağlı bir kullanımdır.

facets.statement: Şafaktan güneş batımına kadar ışığın yayıldığı ve geceye karşıt olan süredir.
Bazı kullanımlarda aydınlık süre, bir günün adı yerine geçer.
Bu zaman adının belirli bir çoğul biçimi de tanıklanmıştır.
Gündüz vaktine sahip olan veya gündüz baskın yapan kişi için yapı bağlı bir niteleme kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin çekirdeği bir şeyi açmak, yarığını genişletmek veya içindekini serbestçe akacak hale getirmektir. Geçici dal imgesi kullanılabilir, ancak her örnekte akış sonucu bulunmadığından genişleme ve açıklık yönü akıştan bağımsız olarak da korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Akış, kan ve bağırsak kullanımlarında belirgindir; açık alan ve yarık genişletmede ise kurucu öğe açıklık veya genişliktir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel açılma ve genişleme çekirdeği korunur; kan, yara, açık alan ve bağırsak kullanımları kendi biçim ve yapılarına bağlanır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi açmak, yarığını genişletmek veya içindekini akacak biçimde serbest bırakmaktır. Bu çekirdek kan akıtma, yara açıklığını büyütme, açık alan, bağırsak boşalması ve genişlik ya da aydınlık benzetmelerinde özelleşir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin açılması, açılması için yarılması veya mevcut açıklığının genişletilmesi temel ilişkidir.
Kanı açılan bir yerden serbest bırakıp akıtma, çekirdeğin akış sonuçlu özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir yaranın veya yarığın açıklığını büyütmek, genişletme çekirdeğinin özel gerçekleşmesidir.
Evlerin önleri arasında kalan ve atıkların bırakıldığı açık alan, açıklık sonucunun adlaşmış uzantısıdır.
Bağırsağın çözülüp akarsu gibi boşalması, akış benzetmesine bağlı bedensel bir kullanımdır.
Genişlik, kimi açıklamalarda su yatağına benzetilir; başka bir anlatımda aydınlıkla birlikte anılır.
Tehlikeler için kullanılan bir biçim, iki ayrı söz öğesinin kaynaştırılmasıyla açıklanan tartışmalı bir türetmedir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt açma ve genişletme çekirdeğini kanın akıtılması, yara açıklığının büyütülmesi ve bir şeyin genişlemesiyle kurar. Açık alan, bağırsak boşalması, genişlik ve aydınlık anlatımları ile birleşik türetme açıklaması bu çekirdeğin farklı uzantılarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kişiyi sert ve azarlayıcı sözle karşılayarak kötü davranıştan caydırma eylemini tutarlı biçimde verir. Sertlik yalnız konuşma tarzı değil, muhataba yöneltilen engelleyici azarın kurucu parçasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel kabalık, suç sayma veya salt susturma değildir; kişiye yöneltilen sert sözlü engelleme yapısıyla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnız kişiye yöneltilen sert sözlü azarlama yapısında tanıklanır ve yalın bir kök anlamı olarak genellenmez.

facets.statement: Muhataba sert ve azarlayıcı söz yönelterek onu kötü bir davranıştan caydırma eylemidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir kişiye sert sözle yöneltilen azarlama ve engellemeyi ortak çekirdek olarak verir. Doğrudan karşılayarak konuşma, eylemin yüz yüze gerçekleşebilen biçimini belirginleştirir.

error_profile.loses: Kötü davranışı engelleme yönünü tek başına açıkça söylemez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözü bazı kuşların yavrusu olarak doğrular, ancak kuş türünü tekleştirmez. Aktarımlar bağırtlak türleri, kartal ve toy kuşu arasında değiştiği için dal kuş yavrusu çekirdeğinde tutulmalı, belirli bir türe indirgenmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu ad genel olarak bütün yavruları kapsamaz; tanıklanan bazı kuşlarla sınırlıdır ve tür aktarımı kaynaklar arasında değişir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kanıt sözü bazı kuşların yavrusu olarak ortaklaştırır, fakat tür konusunda ayrışır. Aktarılan türler bağırtlak benzeri kuşlardan kartala ve toy kuşuna kadar değiştiği için tek bir kuş belirlemek mümkün değildir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal için ortaklaştırılabilecek çok kaynaklı bir anlatım yoktur; kanıt yalın biçimin genel bulut anlamını tek başına tanıklar.

source_details.summary: Genel bulut anlamı bu dalda tek kaynaklı ve ek niteliksiz bir tanıklığa dayanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli bir tür, büyüklük, yağış veya oluşma zamanı eklemeden dalın genel gökyüzü varlığını karşılar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalın biçimin cümle içinde sayılabilir tek bir gökyüzü bulutunu gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ek nitelik taşımayan tek ve genel bir bulut adı bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bulut parçası, yağmur, dolu ve bunlardan türeyen kullanımlar da kapsama girer.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın çekirdeğinde gökyüzündeki bulut bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yalnız genel bulut adıdır; komşu dal bulutun parçasına, yağmura, doluya ve bunlarla ilgili türemiş kullanımlara uzanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutun inceliği, biçimi veya su taşıması konusunda bir sınırlama yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İnce, dağ gibi karşıdan görünen ve çoğu anlatımda su taşımayan bulut olma sınırı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal gökyüzünde görülen bir bulutu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel buluttur; komşu dal ise görünüşü dağa benzeyen, ince ve çoğu aktarımda su taşımayan belirli bir bulut türüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bulutun hareketi, kalış süresi veya su miktarı belirtilmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yerde kalan, ağır ilerleyen ve çok su taşıyabilen bulut olma niteliği bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal tek bir bulut varlığını gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal niteliksiz genel addır; komşu dal bir yerde oyalanan, yavaş hareket eden ve su yüküyle ilişkilendirilen özel bulut türüdür.

Use word_morpheme_spans for any word-level join to QAC.

word_analysis_qac_alignment.note: aligned_qac_word_ref does NOT resolve against qac_morphemes for this ayah: word-analysis counts orthographic words where QAC counts morphological words. Upstream defect in quran-data's word-analysis; deliberately not auto-repaired (renumbering would fabricate identities).

channel_generated_outputs.note: Generated network-v3 channel discovery/family/path outputs are available as external quran-data files; read them only when channel detail is necessary, and do not treat them as an adjudicated channel ledger.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.
